proposal.reason: Trial 1 is the only completed PRIMARY result, using word features at C=0.05 with swap augmentation. The nearest controlled next step is word_C0.1: same representation, same swap rule, same logistic classifier, only C changes. This isolates regularization sensitivity before spending the remaining search fit on a new representation.
proposal.review: Evidence is limited to one PRIMARY trial: word_C0.05 search accuracy 0.62279, train accuracy 0.81456, gap 0.19177, balanced class recalls. No confirmation split is available, and the fitted estimator was logistic though the trial did not declare a classifier. The large train-search gap means the direction of the C change is not established.
proposal.hypothesis: A one-step increase from C=0.05 to C=0.1 will test whether the word route is sensitive to regularization strength; if the current setting is over-regularized, a slightly larger C may help, while no gain would suggest the gap is not mainly a C effect.
proposal.uncertainty: Only one PRIMARY trial exists, so there is no matched evidence for C=0.1 or for any other representation. The observed train-search gap could reflect split shift, overfitting, or underfitting; the direction and magnitude of the next score change are unknown.
